name: asa_agent
description: Asa agent for uni course project

scripts.dev: npm run build && rm -rf -- logs/branch-and-bound/* && BRANCH_AND_BOUND_SVG_ENABLED=true npm run start
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/src/_action-ack.spec.js dist/src/_agent-communication.spec.js dist/src/_communication-logging-tests.js dist/src/_rendezvous-coordination-tests.js dist/src/_grid-formation-coordination-tests.js dist/src/_parcel-handoff.spec.js dist/src/_parcel-handoff-recovery.spec.js dist/src/_parcel-handoff-logging.spec.js dist/src/_option-pruning.spec.js dist/src/_runtime-config.spec.js dist/src/_search-intention.spec.js
scripts.test:communication: npm run build && node --test dist/src/_agent-communication.spec.js dist/src/_communication-logging-tests.js dist/src/_rendezvous-coordination-tests.js dist/src/_grid-formation-coordination-tests.js
scripts.test:missions: npm run build && node --test dist/src/_level-two-mission.test.js dist/src/_level-three-mission-tests.js dist/src/_level-three-json-tests.js dist/src/_grid-formation-coordination-tests.js
scripts.test:handoff: npm run build && node --test dist/src/_parcel-handoff.spec.js dist/src/_parcel-handoff-recovery.spec.js dist/src/_parcel-handoff-logging.spec.js
scripts.ghost-map: npm run build && npm run start
